endpoints.description: Current AQI observations by ZIP code
Raw monitoring data by bounding box and parameter over a time range

limits.notes: Default rate limit ~500 requests/hour per key (confirm in account dashboard). Verify exact hourly cap before relying on it.

llmDocs.summary: Real-time and forecast US air quality (AQI) for ozone, PM2.5, PM10 by ZIP, lat/lon, or bounding box.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Use zipCode or latLong observation endpoints for point lookups; use /aq/data/ with a bounding box (BBOX) for area scans. Request format=application/json explicitly.

exampleQueries.intent: AQI forecast by lat/lon for a date

gotchas: format parameter is literally 'application/json' as a query value, not an Accept header.
Coverage gaps where no nearby monitor exists; empty array means no station in range, not an error.
Hourly rate limit is enforced and resets hourly; batch/cache aggressively.

compliance.redistributionNotes: US federal data, public domain. AirNow ToS requires attribution to AirNow and prohibits implying EPA endorsement.
